name: Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited
summary: Milky Mist Dairy Food Limited produces and supplies dairy products. It engages in food processing, and manufacturing and trading of food products. The company provides dairy products including cheese, paneer, butter, curd, ghee, yogurt, ice cream, milk cream, and UHT milk products. It also offers ready-to-eat and ready-to-cook products, such as frozen pizza, paneer crunchies, paneer tikka, paneer finger, dahi tikki, cheese balls, wheat chapati, malabar parota, coin parota, ragi, idly and dosa batter, and various payasam mix; chocolates and sweetened condensed milk; and traditional Indian sweets such as shrikhand, kalakhand, payasam, mishti doi, and rasgulla.
